CleanPower Group Announces $500M Offshore Wind Expansion in Atlantic

BOSTON - By Elena Rostova | Published October 11, 2026

Historic Capital Commitment to Renewable Infrastructure

CleanPower Group today finalized a landmark $500 million financing package to construct 80 next-generation offshore wind turbines. The facility is expected to supply clean electricity to more than 450,000 coastal households upon completion in late 2028.

"This milestone represents our largest renewable infrastructure project to date," stated CEO David Kim during a press briefing in Boston harbor. "We are proving that zero-carbon generation can deliver dependable grid baseload while creating thousands of union manufacturing jobs."

Environmental Review and Economic Impact

Independent marine biologists conducted a two-year ecological study confirming the deep-water installation minimizes disruption to migratory whales and benthic habitats. Regional economic agencies estimate the facility will generate $1.4 billion in economic activity over its thirty-year operating life.
